create_upload_info_from_path: create an UploadInfo dataclass from a file path to compute its SHA256 hash, size, and sample bytes
create_upload_info_from_bytes: create an UploadInfo dataclass from raw bytes to compute its SHA256 hash, size, and sample bytes
build_lfs_batch_info: build LFS batch upload instructions by posting upload info to the Hugging Face Hub LFS batch endpoint
run_lfs_upload: run an LFS upload of a file to the Hugging Face Hub using single-part or multi-part transfer protocol
test_lfs_upload_multipart: test multi-part LFS upload by splitting a large file into chunks and uploading each part iteratively
